name: Soushitsu no Hibi ~Boukoku no Shounen Hen 2~
original_name: 喪失の日々～某国の少年編2～
source:
Takeru's life with his mother Koyuri and older sister Ayano was uneventful. 
But, recently something was bugging him. 
They were both wrapped up in a "foreign country fad", and he wasn't. 
Specifically, he was clashing with K at school, a student from that country. 

Other than that his life was fine. Takeru didn't really think much about it. 

Then, his sister reached peak obsession, and found out Takeru had this "friend". 
She invited K over to play at his house. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE125594.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
武与母亲小百合、姐姐绫乃一起生活，日子原本平静。
然而最近，有件事让他感到烦恼。她们都沉迷于“外国热潮”，只有他没有。具体来说，他在学校与来自那个国家的学生K发生冲突。

除此之外，生活还算顺利，武没有多想。

后来，姐姐的痴迷达到顶点，发现武有一个来自那个国家的“朋友”。她邀请K到家里玩。
